summary: Building a WhatsApp-like messaging app with real-time chat, user profiles, and contact management.
architectural_notes: Real-time messaging requires WebSocket or similar protocol (e.g., Socket.IO)
Media uploads should use cloud storage (e.g., Firebase Storage or S3)
known_issues: Create profile screen is unresponsive / not working

existing_features.title: Build a React frontend with Internet Identity login. Show a login screen if the user is unauthenticated. After login, check if the user is registered; if not, prompt them to create a profile with a display name.

Build a main chat layout with three panels: a left sidebar listing all conversations (with last message preview, timestamp, and unread count badge), a center chat panel showing message history and a message input bar, and a right panel for contact/profile info. The layout should be responsive and collapse side panels on smaller screens.

Implement message status indicators in the chat panel. Show a single checkmark for sent, double checkmark for delivered (message stored), and double filled/colored checkmark for read (markMessagesRead called by recipient).

Add a contacts screen accessible from the sidebar that lists the user's contacts. Allow searching for other registered users by display name. Provide buttons to add or remove contacts and to start a 1-on-1 conversation with a contact.
Add a 'New Group' flow allowing the authenticated user to select multiple contacts, enter a group name, and create a group conversation. The group should then appear in the conversations sidebar.
Add a user profile settings screen where the authenticated user can update their display name and avatar URL. Changes should be persisted via updateProfile.

Apply a clean, modern dark-mode visual theme inspired by contemporary messaging apps. Use a deep charcoal/dark green color palette with high-contrast white text, teal or emerald accent colors for sent message bubbles and active states, subtle gray for received message bubbles, and a clean sans-serif typeface. Enforce the theme consistently across all screens.
Render the generated app logo image as a static asset in the frontend. Display it on the login/welcome screen.

Diagnose and fix the ProfileSetupModal so that submitting a display name (and optional avatar URL) successfully calls the backend registerUser function and transitions the user into the main chat layout without the form becoming unresponsive or hanging.

new_feature_requests.summary: User registration and authentication (phone number or email)
Contact list and user profile management

Implement a backend actor that stores users, conversations, and messages. Each user has a principal ID, display name, avatar URL, and status. Each conversation tracks participants and metadata. Each message has a sender, timestamp, text content, and read status.

Implement backend functions for user registration and profile management: registerUser(displayName, avatarUrl), updateProfile(displayName, avatarUrl), getMyProfile(), getUserProfile(userId). Authentication is based on Internet Identity principal.
Implement backend functions for contact/friend management: addContact(userId), removeContact(userId), getContacts(). A contact list is stored per user.

Implement backend functions for conversations and messaging: createConversation(participantIds, isGroup, groupName), sendMessage(conversationId, text), getMessages(conversationId, limit, offset), markMessagesRead(conversationId), getConversations(). Support both 1-on-1 and group conversations.
